title: Matt Rhule Breaks Silence With Subtle Note as Dylan Raiola Enters Portal - NewsBreak
text:
By Sarthak Khanna ,
47 minutes ago
Matt Rhule (Image Credits: Imagn) As the college football transfer portal prepares to open in just a few days, Nebraska head coach Matt Rhile appears unaffected by the potential roster shakeups. The program navigates renewed uncertainty surrounding quarterback Dylan Raiola’s future.
Speaking candidly about the upcoming portal window, Rhule emphasized stability over panic. He pointed to Nebraska’s recent re-signings and growing appeal among players outside the program. Ever since the exit of OC John Butler , the team has been struggling in multiple ways. While the transfer portal has become a source of anxiety for many coaches across the country, Rhule made it clear that Nebraska is operating from a position of confidence rather than concern.
“I mean, we’ve resigned a lot of guys to contracts, and they can’t anticipate being here,” Rhule said. “There’s some guys that, you know, they have to make decisions that’s best for them, so we’re not super worried about it,” he continued.
While Rhule did not mention Raiola by name, he directed his remarks toward him and other athletes like him. “There’s a lot of guys who’d like to come to University of Nebraska, and we’re in a good position, So Pat, and those guys are well positioned to do that,” Rhule concluded.
Matt Rhule Appears to Be in Trouble if Dylan Raiola Leaves Matt Rhule (Image Credits: Imagn) Locked On Nebraska host Mitch Sherman dropped his take on the current situation of Nebraska and Rhule’s coaching evolution recently. Connor Happer and Rhule discussed how Matt likes things done in a certain way. However, other coaches often do not receive this well.
“Matt Rhule, if he was trying to point himself in the direction of being the CEO, very clearly he can’t help himself,” Sherman said. “He can’t help himself but to really get in the nitty-gritty and have his imprint on everything,” Mitch Sherman stated.
This discussion began when Rhule recently acknowledged that he needs to focus more on actual coaching rather than just administrative work, which has occupied him for the past few months. With many good coaches and players leaving Nebraska, Rhule will need to develop a master plan soon. For now, the team is focusing on the 2025 SRS Distribution Las Vegas Bowl.
